issue_context.title: Security hardening: bounds checking in ring buffer code
comments: May as well harden it. PR #21895

review_comments: Would it be better to restrict the max amount we ever allocate to MAX_OFFSET, so that `ring_buf_avail()` will never be more than that - which would render this check unnecessary.

We don't allocate anywhere near that much — obviously we never allocate `1<<62` bytes of memory. But the `head_offset` field tracks the logical offset in a QUIC stream — so we might have a 4k ring buffer but where the offsets have reached e.g. `1<<60` etc. A QUIC stream can't be used further once it reaches the limit, so this limitation aligns perfectly with QUIC.
